description: Defines the abstract class rx::FramebufferImpl for framebuffer operations in the ANGLE graphics library, including virtual methods for managing framebuffer state, reading pixels, clearing buffers, and other rendering tasks.

classes.name: rx::FramebufferImpl
classes.description: An abstract base class for framebuffer implementations, providing an interface for framebuffer operations.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Virtual method to destroy the framebuffer object.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Virtual method to discard framebuffer contents.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Virtual method to invalidate framebuffer attachments.

methods.name: invalidateSub
methods.description: Virtual method to invalidate a sub-region of the framebuffer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Virtual method to clear the framebuffer with a mask.

methods.name: clearBufferfv
methods.description: Virtual method to clear a buffer with float values.

methods.name: clearBufferuiv
methods.description: Virtual method to clear a buffer with unsigned int values.

methods.name: clearBufferiv
methods.description: Virtual method to clear a buffer with int values.

methods.name: clearBufferfi
methods.description: Virtual method to clear depth and stencil buffers.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadFormat
methods.description: Virtual method to get the color read format.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadType
methods.description: Virtual method to get the color read type.

methods.name: readPixels
methods.description: Virtual method to read pixels from the framebuffer.

methods.name: blit
methods.description: Virtual method to blit (copy) framebuffer contents.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Virtual method to check framebuffer completeness.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Virtual method to synchronize framebuffer state.

methods.name: getSamplePosition
methods.description: Virtual method to get the position of a sample.

methods.name: shouldSyncStateBeforeCheckStatus
methods.description: Method indicating if state sync is needed before checkStatus.
